rows.claim: The estate's inference rule for banking a claim is trivalent and typed: exit 0 banks, exit 2 blocks with its own evidence file, and the undecidable middle escalates to a human wire instead of a guess, which is how the estate metabolizes Godel instead of dying of it.
rows.quote: The 0/1/2 exit contract is a typed trivalent logic: pass, refutable violation, undecidable
rows.steal: One sitting: before the next grader you touch in tools/ runs, stamp its verdict conditions into the docstring as explicit exit semantics (0 pass / 1 soft WARN with reason / 2 block plus evidence path), the same shape workflow_gate.py already carries at tools/workflow_gate.py:10-11; landing spot: the tool's docstring plus a scenario card if it joins the gate.
rows.falsifier: A landed gate whose exit 1 silently blocks a push, or whose exit 2 is survived by a passing verdict with only a WARN row, would falsify the trivalent contract as the estate's actual banking rule.

rows.law: census denominator law (instrument-and-moment typing of counts)
rows.claim: Collected and executed counts are non-commuting observables over one moving tree, so a count banks only when it names instrument, moment, and delta, and two counts from different moments are never differenced except through named landings between them (B2-216 attributed the 55-61 gap to 64 byte-counted window files).
rows.quote: never difference two counts taken at different moments
rows.steal: One sitting: before quoting any test count, run the count yourself and write it in the parseable census grammar (N tests / M files with a parenthesized census date) so tools/census_drift_patrol.py can gate it; landing spot: the AGENTS.md census bullet you refresh.
rows.falsifier: A same-instrument delta between two moments that reconciles byte-exactly with zero named landings in the window and reproduces identically on re-run would falsify the landing-attribution rule the law stands on.

rows.law: 0-corroborated equilibrium (corroboration is a threshold-2 public good)
rows.claim: CORROBORATED requires two distinct non-author witnesses, so with exactly one volunteer (the operator) the top rung is structurally unreachable, and demand flows to the weak ungated instrument: the Dirac bank, which context_pack consumes daily as a raw line count.
rows.quote: The v4 ladder was designed for a republic of seats and is played by two; its upper rungs are empty
rows.steal: One sitting: during the next gala wave, witness one sibling lane's grounding_wave claim row under your own seat name (the second distinct seat makes corroboration reachable for the first time); landing spot: watch/GROUNDING_WAVE.jsonl, then read `ADMISSION: N corroborated` in the next verify run, which w4-trust-game.md:190 names as the metric to watch leaving 0.
rows.falsifier: ADMISSION corroborated rising above 0 while every witness row still carries seat=operator or the author's own seat would falsify the structural-unreachability reading and show the rung is cheap after all.
